data.exact_reserve_text: The adverse impacts to the underwriting result were partially offset by a release from prior year reserves of GBP 59.2m (2016, GBP 57.6m release). This release is a result of more favourable claims development than originally anticipated and the work of our claims department in dealing with claims in an expeditious manner.

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a net release from prior year reserves of GBP 59.2m, attributed to more favourable claims development and efficient claims handling. This favourable development was substantially offset by an adverse GBP 52.4m strengthening attributable to the Ogden discount rate change affecting UK Motor treaty reserves. Separately, 2017 suffered GBP 74.7m of natural catastrophe losses (Harvey, Irma, Maria, Mexico City earthquake, Northern and Southern California wildfires, Nate) which materially impacted the underwriting result.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' amount was provided. The report explicitly states a net release from prior year reserves of GBP 59.2m (used here as the quantified prior year movement) and separately discloses a GBP 52.4m adverse impact from the Ogden discount rate change. A gross claims development triangle exists but is distorted by an RITC accepted from Syndicate 1400 (gross RITC shown in Technical Provisions), which can affect interpretations of movements; hence gross PYD not directly available in a single explicit gross line and net figure was used.
